description: Override the app's clock. set_time moves it to `time` (ISO 8601, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' in the device's zone, epoch ms, or relative like '+30d'), optionally frozen. shift jumps by `by` ('+1d', '-2h30m', '90s'); a forward shift also runs app setTimeout/setInterval callbacks that come due inside the jump, once each. freeze/resume stop and restart it, set_rate runs it faster (60 = a minute per second), reset returns to real time. To test token refresh: jump_to_token_expiry moves the app's clock to `leadMs` (default 10000) before a token expires, for apps that refresh before expiry; fail_next_request answers the next request to that token's API with a 401 once, for apps that refresh after a 401. Both start a refresh check; read get_clock after the app sends a request to see whether a new token arrived. stop_token_check ends it and withdraws an unfired 401. Moves Date.now(), new Date() and no-argument Intl formatting; performance.now(), animations, native timers, the time zone and the backend's clock stay real. Screens that already computed a time keep it until they re-read the clock or the app reloads; the override survives reload_app.

by.description: shift (required): signed duration like '+1d', '-2h30m', '90s', or ms.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

fireTimers.description: shift: run app timers that come due inside a forward jump. Default on.

freeze.description: set_time: stop the clock at `time`. Default false.

leadMs.description: jump_to_token_expiry: land this many ms before expiry. Default 10000.

persist.description: settings: keep the override across reloads.

showChip.description: settings: show the floating clock chip while overridden.

times.description: fail_next_request: how many requests to fail, 1-10. Default 1.

token.description: jump_to_token_expiry / fail_next_request: token id from get_clock. Default: the most recently used token.

name: clock_action
